result.summary: VERIFY_ONLY mapping of existing World Prompt, commit, event, idempotency and revision contracts into an explicit two-client LOCAL authoritative POC test matrix. Server owns world_revision, entity set, ownership and commit receipts. Valid path is preview → confirm → commit (server_authoritative only). Fail-closed rejects: direct client write, forged actor/client/owner, stale expected_world_revision, invalid schema, out-of-order event, altered receipt. Idempotency: same request_id + same payload → same receipt no duplicate; same key + different payload → conflict. Convergence: both clients share revision + entity_set_hash. Reconnect: replay from last ack revision or explicit snapshot resync; never silent divergence. API surfaces defined for M1 network server simulator and M2 Godot two-client harness. Not Nakama/Colyseus. No product or contracts edits.

g1_002_residuals_carried.statement: Schema-valid commit_request can still be client-forged by lying about authority labels. Service identity must not trust client-asserted authority JSON alone.
g1_002_residuals_carried.m1_mitigation: M1 binds every commit attempt to a registered client_session_id / client_id established at connect. Server ignores client-supplied authority.source for admission; server stamps authority on receipt. Direct entity write APIs do not exist. Forged actor_id / owner_id that do not match the authenticated session fail closed with rejection.code client_forged or auth_failed / ownership.
M1 stores confirmed world_prompt by prompt_id/request_id; commit applies that stored body only. Commit without prior confirmed prompt → rejected confirmation_missing or schema_invalid.

g1_002_residuals_carried.statement: No machine link from confirmed world_prompt → commit_request.
g1_002_residuals_carried.m1_mitigation: Server requires matching request_id + prompt_id + confirmed state before apply.

g1_002_residuals_carried.statement: Event payload secret blocklist is keyword-shallow.
g1_002_residuals_carried.m1_mitigation: POC outbox builds payload from server fields only (receipt_id, entity_ids, revisions, entity_set_hash); never copies client payload wholesale.
Executable store + race tests required in M1 test matrix.

g1_002_residuals_carried.statement: Receipt schema does not force new_world_revision > old_world_revision.
g1_002_residuals_carried.m1_mitigation: On committed, M1 MUST set new = old + 1 and refuse decreasing revisions internally.

world_revision.rule: Monotonically non-decreasing; advances by exactly 1 on each successful committed durable apply. Clients may propose expected_world_revision but never set server head.

entity_set.rule: Canonical active entity map lives only on server. Clients hold local mirrors for render/prediction; mirrors are untrusted until equal to server snapshot/event apply.
entity_set.entity_set_hash: Server computes and returns; clients verify equality for convergence.

ownership.rule: Server decides entity ownership / actor eligibility. Client-asserted owner_id or actor_id that does not match registered session fails closed (rejection ownership | client_forged | auth_failed).
ownership.poc_model: Each client registers { client_id, actor_id, actor_type } at connect; only that actor may confirm/commit under that session for player mutations.

commit_receipts.rule: Only server issues commit_receipt with authority.issuer=world_commit_service. Clients must not mint or rewrite receipts. Altered receipt fields fail integrity check on client apply path.

event_outbox.rule: Only server emits world.mutation_committed envelopes after committed. event_id server-assigned UUID. Consumers idempotent by event_id.

idempotency.key: request_id (uuid) — aligns with commit_request.request_id and world_prompt.request_id

same_key_same_payload.rule: Second commit with identical request_id and identical payload fingerprint returns status idempotent_replay with prior_receipt_id of original, same old/new world_revision and entity_ids; NO second entity; NO revision bump; NO second outbox mutation event required (optional audit only)

same_key_different_payload.rule: Same request_id with different confirmed world_prompt fingerprint / commit-affecting fields MUST NOT apply either as silent overwrite. Return conflicted or rejected with stable code (recommended: conflicted with code revision_mismatch only if revision also wrong; else rejected policy OR conflicted with POC code documented as idempotency_payload_mismatch). Prefer: status rejected, rejection.code policy, reason includes idempotency payload mismatch; OR extend conflict object in product if needed WITHOUT editing contracts in M0 — M1 documents exact code in M1 receipt. State unchanged.
same_key_different_payload.g5_parallel: Same class as G5 INV-IDEMPOTENCY-FINGERPRINT — key alone is insufficient; bind canonical fingerprint

convergence.definition: After Client A valid commit and Client B has applied the corresponding committed event or completed snapshot resync, both clients report identical server-authoritative world_revision and entity_set_hash.
required_equal_fields: per-entity entity_hash for all active entities (optional strong check)
convergence.rejected_paths: Any RC-* rejection leaves both clients' observed server head equal to pre-attack head (Client B never sees a mutation that did not commit).

rules.rule: Client reconnects with last_ack_world_revision (and optional last_ack_event_id). Server replays outbox events with world_revision > last_ack in order until head.
rules.success: Client applies each event once (idempotent by event_id); ends at server head revision + entity_set_hash

rules.rule: If gap too large, events missing, integrity fail, or out-of-order detected: server provides explicit WorldStateSnapshot (revision + entity set + entity_set_hash). Client replaces local mirror atomically.
rules.forbidden: Silent merge of partial local prediction with incomplete events

rules.rule: Replayed events and reconnect must not double-apply mutations. Server commit idempotency remains request_id-based; client event apply is event_id-based.
If client cannot verify revision continuity or hash equality after replay, it MUST fail closed to snapshot resync or structured error — never continue with divergent local truth.
